### 2026-10-01 — ## Planning and Initial Setup

**2h**

## Planning and Initial Setup

Today I started working on my Smart Study Light project. The idea is to build a small desk light that automatically turns on when the surroundings become dark and turns off when there is enough light.

I created the GitHub repository for the project and connected it to my project. I also planned the main components needed for the circuit. I already have an Arduino, LED, breadboard, and jumper wires, and I added an LDR light sensor and a 10KΩ resistor to the bill of materials.

My next step is to build the circuit, write the Arduino code, and test whether the light responds correctly to changes in the surrounding brightness.
